text:
Type: woven bamboo dome pendant lamp
Use: ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, Japandi, coastal
Materials: woven bamboo shade, brushed nickel ceiling cup and top fitting, white fabric cord
Colors: warm natural bamboo, light beige, silver
Shape: wide dome shade with an open diamond lattice weave that casts patterned light, hangs on a long cord, large but light and airy
Feel: warm, natural, relaxed, cozy
Goes with: light wood, linen, rattan, green plants, white walls; bohemian, Japandi or coastal rooms
